name: Methodology cockpit voice clarifier
description: In-context ElevenLabs ConvAI clarifier on the /admin/methodology card detail. Consumes @caistech/elevenlabs-convai (/react VoiceWidget). The agent pulls the current card's state (get_card_state) and the methodology definitions (get_methodology_context) on demand; it helps the operator with Gate 1 readiness, what 'Launch real research' fires, and which Gate-2 decision fits the card. Guide/clarifier scope — no cross-session memory loop.

env_vars.name: GITHUB_PACKAGES_TOKEN
env_vars.description: read:packages token to install @caistech/elevenlabs-convai from GitHub Packages (consumed as NODE_AUTH_TOKEN by .npmrc).

env_vars.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
env_vars.description: ElevenLabs key (BYOK). Used to provision the clarifier agent AND the agent runs on it, so all voice cost lands on the operator's ElevenLabs account.

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_ELEVENLABS_AGENT_COCKPIT_CLARIFIER
env_vars.description: Provisioned ConvAI agent id for the cockpit clarifier. The widget renders only when this resolves (env var, or the baked fallback in src/voice.config.ts). Produced by the provisioning script.
env_vars.where: set on Vercel, or baked into src/voice.config.ts as the COCKPIT_CLARIFIER_AGENT_ID fallback

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
env_vars.description: App public URL — used to derive the agent allowlist + base URL at provision time. Defaults to https://corporate-ai-solutions.vercel.app.

external_setup.title: Provision the cockpit clarifier ConvAI agent (ElevenLabs)
external_setup.description: Creates (or idempotently updates) the 'CAS Methodology Cockpit Clarifier' agent on the operator's ElevenLabs workspace, declares the get_card_state + get_methodology_context client tools, enables conversation_config overrides, and writes the Security allowlist (prod + *.vercel.app + localhost). Prints the agent id to wire in.
steps: From the project root run: npm run provision:clarifier
Set NEXT_PUBLIC_ELEVENLABS_AGENT_COCKPIT_CLARIFIER=<agentId> on Vercel (Production + Preview), OR paste it as the COCKPIT_CLARIFIER_AGENT_ID fallback in src/voice.config.ts.
Redeploy. Open a card at /admin/methodology/<slug> — the floating clarifier should appear; click it and ask 'is this card ready for Gate 1?' to confirm the get_card_state pull works.
